post.summary: Assign an action to a board button
Assign a role to a board LED
Pause or resume streaming to the bridge
Activate the verified PCM transport key
Discard the pending PCM transport key
Retire the PCM transport rollback key
Restore the previous PCM transport key
Generate and stage a per-device PCM transport key
Verify the pending PCM transport key against the bridge
Return to cleartext and replace an unusable pending key

profile_id.description: Empty returns to custom audio settings.

AnalogPassthroughCapability.description:
One board-wired local analog output that the selected codec can route from
every advertised input.

input_line.description: Selected input, one of the resolved board's advertised lines.

Board.description:
What a board offers the user. The status API advertises this and the
settings API validates against it, so the two cannot diverge.

adc_atten_max_db.description: Upper bound of the ADC attenuation control, in dB.

oneOf.description:
Local analog monitoring output, absent when the board has no supported
route.

buttons.description:
Board buttons the user can assign actions to, in console order. Empty
when the board wires none.

codec.description: Codec driver and bus address needed to control line-in capture.

id.description:
Stable descriptor id. Official presets and custom boards share this
identity shape.

input_gain_max.description: Upper bound of the input gain control, as a 0..=100 percentage.

input_lines.description:
Selectable inputs in console order, never empty; the first entry is
the factory default.

leds.description:
Board LEDs the user can assign roles to, in console order. Empty when the
board wires none.

pins.description: ESP32 GPIO wiring for codec control and I2S capture.

BoardSettingsRequest.description: Select exactly one built-in id or a JSON-encoded custom descriptor.

descriptor.description: JSON-encoded descriptor, capped at 3072 UTF-8 bytes by the device.

Button.description:
One board button wired to an ESP32 input GPIO, with the action it fires
until the user assigns another.

active_low.description:
`true` when the GPIO reads low while the button is held. The firmware
enables the matching internal pull where the pin has one; input-only
pins (GPIO 34–39) rely on the board's own resistor.

default_action.description:
Action fired until the user assigns another, so a board author can ship
useful presses while leaving spare buttons inert.

id.description:
Stable id, unique within the board, used to address the button in
settings.

label.description: Human-readable name the console shows for this button.

ButtonAction.description: The action assigned to a single board button, fired on a simple press.

ButtonSettingsRequest.description: Assign one board button, named by its capabilities id, a new action.

CheckStatus.description: The outcome of one check, independent of how much it matters.

CodecSpec.description: Codec hardware mounted on the board.

i2c_address.description: 7-bit I2C address the codec answers on.

button_actions.description: The effective action of every board button, in descriptor order.

led_roles.description: The effective role of every board LED, in descriptor order.

HealthCheck.description: One thing the startup check looked at.

detail.description: Plain-language description of what the check found.

fixable.description: Whether the console offers an action that resolves it.

id.description: Stable machine id, e.g. `"codec"`. Scripts and the console key off this.

remedy.description: What the user does about it, when there is something to do.

HealthReport.description: The startup verdict: every check plus the worst severity across them.

InputOption.description: One selectable input, with the label the console shows for it.

Led.description:
One board LED wired to an ESP32 output GPIO, with the role it takes until
the user assigns another.

active_low.description: `true` when driving the GPIO low lights the LED.

default_role.description:
Role applied until the user assigns another, so a board author can wire a
status light while leaving decorative LEDs dark.

id.description: Stable id, unique within the board, used to address the LED in settings.

label.description: Human-readable name the console shows for this LED.

LedRole.description: The behavior assigned to a single board LED.

LedSettingsRequest.description: Assign one board LED, named by its capabilities id, a new role.

NvsStatus.description: NVS configuration partition usage, in 32-byte entries.

OtaUpdateRequest.description: Empty installs the latest release. A custom install requires both fields.

url.description:
HTTP(S) download URL. Query parameters are preserved; userinfo and
fragments are rejected.

PinMap.description: ESP32 GPIO wiring used by the board's audio hardware.

Severity.description:
How much a check's outcome matters to the user journey. A report's overall
[`HealthReport::status`] is the worst severity across its checks.

checks.detail: The Ai-Thinker ESP32 Audio Kit v2.2 (ES8388) audio codec answered and is streaming-ready.

StreamControlStatus.description:
Runtime streaming control, flipped by `POST /api/stream` and the
`toggle_stream` button action. Not persisted: a reboot resumes streaming.

StreamRequest.description:
Runtime streaming control; the choice is not persisted and a reboot
resumes streaming.

SystemStatus.description: Device resource headroom: RAM, NVS storage, uptime, and task count.

target_host.description: Hostname or IP without a scheme, port, or path. Empty clears the target.

psk.description: Shown once. The device never returns this PSK through a read endpoint.

admin_secret.description:
Generated 48-character lowercase-hex admin key. Empty preserves the
stored key.

password.description: Wi-Fi password. Empty preserves the stored password.

ssid.description: Wi-Fi network name. Empty names are rejected.

target_host.description: Optional bridge host set during first commissioning.
